quote.translation: Becker also holds, however, that N (•p) and U (•-p) form symmetrical modalities (symmetrischer Modus) through a change of sign, as do M (-•-p) and M′ (-•p), and W (p) and F (-p).

quote.translation: If, in this figure, we take WF as the central axis and consider the symmetry to the left and right, the standpoint of the second system appears; and if we take the modalities above the horizontal line as one set and those below it as another, the standpoint of the third system appears.

regions.text: さうして第二の體系の見地から「必然性の論理」と「可能性の論理とを對立させ、一方にNとひとを確置性の頬似において捉へ、他方にMXM'の共通傾域（dasgemeinsameGcbict）を間題性において捉へてゐる。

quote.translation: From the standpoint of the second system he sets "the logic of necessity" against "the logic of possibility", grasping N and U, on the one hand, in their similarity as apodictic, and on the other hand grasping the common domain (das gemeinsame Gebiet) of M×M′ as problematic.
